faq.q: What is Utility Truck (Contender-based) in GTA 6?
faq.a: Utility Truck (Contender-based) is a vehicle listed for GTA 6 on the GTA Fandom wiki, made in game by Vapid. The wiki entry is the only record of it. Rockstar has not named it in a trailer, a press release or on the Grand Theft Auto VI site, so this page records the wiki listing and marks it as a community source.

faq.q: Is Utility Truck (Contender-based) confirmed for GTA 6?
faq.a: No. A Fandom wiki page is written by fans, not by Rockstar. This site files Utility Truck (Contender-based) as community identified, at low confidence, for that reason. The entry stays at low confidence until Rockstar or a major outlet names it.

faq.q: What does the wiki say about Utility Truck (Contender-based)?
faq.a: The wiki gives 4 details. Manufacturer: Vapid. Class: Utility. Body style: 2-door utility pickup truck. Seats: 2. Those are wiki fields copied as they stand. No figure here was measured in the game, because the game has not released.

faq.q: Where does this Utility Truck (Contender-based) information come from?
faq.a: From the GTA Fandom wiki page for Utility Truck (Contender-based), collected by the outlawdb project on 2026-09-13 and released under CC BY-SA 3.0. The source link on this page opens the wiki page itself, so you can read the same entry.

faq.q: What is still unknown about Utility Truck (Contender-based)?
faq.a: Most of it. Utility Truck (Contender-based) rests on a fan wiki listing and nothing else. Top speed, handling and stats and a gta 6 price are both unpublished. Rockstar answers questions like this at launch, not before, so this page will change when it does.

faq.q: Will Utility Truck (Contender-based) be in the finished GTA 6?
faq.a: Not known. A wiki listing is a claim by a fan editor, not a Rockstar statement. Plenty of vehicle entries written before a launch never appear in the game. This site records the claim and the source, and marks the entry unconfirmed until that changes.
